case_name: Text on screen in a clip
title: Mountain Morning Opening Title
tests: Checks exact, legible title-card text, its opening placement and duration, and the transition into moving scenery.

faults.what: The title card is still visible at 2.3 seconds, so the cut occurs later than the requested 2-second mark and leaves less time for the lake shot.

judge.summary: The clip delivers the correct title and a gently moving misty sunrise lake scene, but the title holds beyond the requested two seconds.

must_haves.item: The opening title reads exactly 'A quieter kind of morning', with no quotation marks or extra text.
must_haves.why: The title matches exactly, and no other text is visible.

must_haves.item: The title is legible cream lettering on a dark green card, fully inside the frame.
must_haves.why: The cream title is clearly readable against dark green with ample margins.

must_haves.item: The title card occupies approximately the first 2 seconds, then cuts to the lake scene.
must_haves.why: The frame at 2.3 seconds still shows the full title card; the lake is visible by 3.8 seconds, placing the transition later than requested.

must_haves.item: The remaining scene shows a misty mountain lake at sunrise with visible slow camera or scene motion.
must_haves.why: The lake has mountain reflections, drifting mist, and warm sunrise light; the later frames show subtle changes in foreground framing and mist.

must_haves.item: The delivered video is silent, 16:9 and approximately 6 seconds long.
must_haves.why: The supplied duration is 6 seconds, the frames are 16:9, and the audio report confirms no audible sound.
